summary: Add a domain-neutral Git-aware verification impact classifier without coupling verification scope to SemVer.

candidates.rationale: Add the universal rule separating iteration blast-radius classification from mandatory pre-commit full regression.
Define domain-neutral sensitive paths, prefixes, and verification scopes in inspectable machine policy.
Implement deterministic Git change discovery and SCOPED_VALIDATION versus FULL_REGRESSION classification.
Add adversarial coverage for staged, unstaged, untracked, sensitive, and scoped change classification.
Integrate Step 3 into existing routed metadata and capability indexes without creating a competing route.

applied_changes.description: Added Convention 28 for verification-scope blast radius.
Integrated Step 3 into routed workspace metadata and indexes.
